name: Evidence residency fixed-trace provider measurement
mode: controlled tool history plus one real provider completion; not autonomous agent solving
fixedTrace: Read version 1; exact patch to version 2; read version 2; assemble; repeat same full read twice, assembling each time. Then make one real streaming completion to implement inverseScale from current source.
acceptance: Independent sandboxed numeric tests of returned inverseScale on current source transformation; no follow-up model repair. This is a tiny controlled coding question, not a DeepSWE score.
unknownBilling: Retain full 1 USD allocation for affected attempt; no retries or zero-valued missing totals; continue only other fixed attempts.
comparison: Same source and tool history; assert the only request-content differences are the two repeated read result bodies. Compare actual provider input/output/cache usage and answer acceptance; report separately from autonomous DeepSWE.
runTiming: After all eight main DeepSWE attempts, not concurrent. Previous and main-round reservations remain separate.
scope: Intentionally activates a read-after-edit cache path. It does not estimate how frequently real agents hit this path or establish general coding quality.
scriptHashEncoding: UTF-8 source with LF line endings
providerPackaging: Actual ContextOS-projected observations are provided in a single user message; no fabricated model turns or thinking signatures. Tool definitions remain equal. This is a controlled context experiment, not a native autonomous conversation.
